issue: `Bank.transfer()` lets an account go negative. A transfer of more than the source balance, or of a non-positive amount, must raise InsufficientFunds / ValueError respectively and leave BOTH balances unchanged.
prompt_template:
Bug report for the project in {workdir}:

`Bank.transfer()` lets an account go negative. A transfer of more than the source balance, or of a non-positive amount, must raise InsufficientFunds / ValueError respectively and leave BOTH balances unchanged.

Fix the bug in the source code (not the tests). Run the tests with `pytest -q`. When you're done, reply with a short summary of what you changed and whether the tests pass.
